assumptions.claim: Twenty-four semver-ordered NVM installations are sufficient for common supported layouts while keeping discovery bounded.
assumptions.evidence: A 31-directory fixture proves numeric order and an exact cap of 24; current user runtime v24.18.0 falls within that bounded set.

assumptions.claim: Supported Vercel CLI releases expose a version-shaped result from --version without requiring authentication.
assumptions.evidence: Installed CLI 59.1.4 and hermetic fixtures return semver; invalid non-empty output is rejected by a dedicated regression and mutation.

assumptions.claim: Only launch-level failure invalidates the plan; timeout and ordinary API errors do not switch installations.
assumptions.evidence: Dedicated timeout and API-error tests observe one version probe and one service command, while exit 127 triggers re-resolution without replay.

assumptions.claim: The added controlled resolution probe does not mutate a fresh HOME, while whoami and arbitrary CLI commands retain CLI-owned behavior.
assumptions.evidence: A real Process probe against a fresh HOME leaves only the pre-created bin fixture; authentication is tested separately.

side_effects.evidence: Resolution and service execution launch external processes. Service commands may have remote effects, so automatic replay is prohibited.
